set.body:
Objective
Complete the non-mask components of the recognition decomposition and produce one final HTML report.

Scope
Use canonical Transport v3 candidate evidence. Infer true-minus-nonmatch margin and top-one sensitivity; replace each participant own-study candidate with four deterministic same-item, same-version episodes from other participants; score old/lure and newtest without response-based selection; compare own versus group templates; open behavior only after measurement; retain density as the declared simple comparator. Exact visibility-mask reconstruction and visible/invisible-region analysis are explicitly out of scope.

Acceptance criteria
1. Candidate-margin and top-one intervals use crossed participant/item uncertainty.
2. Other-participant templates contain four episodes, exclude the retrieval participant, match item and intended image version, and are selected deterministically without outcomes.
3. Newtest is a no-own-memory control scored only from other-participant templates.
4. Own-over-group behavioral prediction is outer-fold held out and adjusts for saliency, gaze quality, and group evidence.
5. Tests include analytic margin behavior, row permutation, deterministic donors, self-participant exclusion, newtest support, and local checkpoint alignment.
6. Trial-linked outputs remain local and Git-ignored.
7. A self-contained HTML report separates reliable detection, trivial/perceptual controls, null behavioral results, limitations, and the exact-mask work deferred by scope.
set.title: GW-22 Own-versus-group recognition decomposition and final HTML report
